text:
ash: Quick status check — did the KV eviction tuning PR land? need to align canary by EOD.
maya: merged into feature/kv-evict-tuner earlier today, but still waiting on @taylor for perf review.
taylor: looking now. ran a quick bench on the dev canary: p50 ~= 12ms, p95 42ms, p99 110ms with cont-batch=8.
raj: those p99s are higher than what we saw in staging. did we accidentally change the prefetch window somewhere?
taylor: good catch — prefetch window was 64 -> accidentally set to 16 in the canary config. reverted locally and p99 improved to ~68ms.
ash: @taylor can you paste the config snippet you used so we can sync?
taylor: ```json
{
  "continuous_batch_size": 8,
  "kv_prefetch_window": 64,
  "kv_eviction_policy": "age_weighted",
  "max_concurrent_requests": 256
}
```
maya: also FYI the kernel fallback ordering change in PR #482 could affect eviction ordering. @raj does that interact here?
raj: it does — the fallback now moves older keys to the tail before eviction. combined with a small prefetch window that's a plausible cause of the spike. i'll add a unit test and a note in the PR.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for sha abc123 to zone us-west-2 (3/6 shards) :rocket: 
ash: plan: revert prefetch to 64 in canary, run a 30m steady load, collect p95/p99 and cache-hit ratio. if p99 < 80ms and hit ratio >= 0.88, we promote.
taylor: pushing a hotfix to the canary config now. ping me once the canary stabilizes.
maya: ownership check — who owns follow-up to add a monitoring alert for KV hit-rate drop? @raj?
raj: assigning to myself. i'll add an alert: hit_rate < 0.82 for 5m -> page, and a short runbook that triggers immediate fallback to the smaller-state variant.
nash: small blocker: the PR that changes mem-metrics schema is still pending review in infra. @infra-bot any ETA?
infra-bot: codecov-bot: PR 521 in infra-metrics waiting on review from @sam. no activity in 18h.
nash: @sam can you peek? this blocks dashboards for the canary.
sam: on it — i'll review in the next 30m. if it's critical i'll approve and request follow-ups rather than block the canary.
taylor: canary metrics update: after reverting prefetch, current p95=46ms, p99=73ms, hit_ratio=0.903. looks promising :thumbsup: 
maya: nice. if no regressions in 45m, can we schedule a promotion window? prefer low-traffic slot 02:00 UTC.
nash: agreed. i'll book the promo and add a rollback window. thanks all.
taylor: one last note — i'll open a follow-up ticket to decouple fallback ordering from eviction policy and assign it to the kernel team.
nash: :white_check_mark: closing loop — Raj to add alert, Sam to merge mem-metrics, Taylor to open ticket, Maya to schedule promo, Ash to coordinate promotion.
